```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)

library(FLSAM)
library(FLCore)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(knitr)
library(DT)

dt <- function(df, caption = NULL, digits = NULL, pagelength = 20) {
  DT::datatable(df, caption = caption, rownames = FALSE,
                options = list(pageLength = pagelength, dom = "t", ordering = FALSE),
                class = "stripe hover") -> tbl
  if (!is.null(digits)) tbl <- DT::formatRound(tbl, columns = digits, digits = 4)
  tbl
}

theme_set(theme_bw())

# every figure below is also written to report/figures/model_comparison/ as a PNG
# at print resolution (same helper as report.Rmd's save_and_show), then embedded
FIG_DIR <- "report/figures/model_comparison"
dir.create(FIG_DIR, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

save_and_show <- function(p, filename, width = 10, height = 6.5, dpi = 300) {
  path <- file.path(FIG_DIR, filename)
  if (inherits(p, "ggplot")) {
    ggsave(path, plot = p, width = width, height = height, dpi = dpi, bg = "white")
  } else {
    png(path, width = width, height = height, units = "in", res = dpi, bg = "white")
    on.exit(dev.off())
    p()
  }
  knitr::include_graphics(path)
}

# sequential figure numbering, assigned in the order figures actually appear
.fig_n <- 0
fig <- function(caption = NULL) {
  .fig_n <<- .fig_n + 1
  if (is.null(caption)) paste0("Figure ", .fig_n)
  else paste0("Figure ", .fig_n, ": ", caption)
}

as_series <- function(flq, name) {
  df <- as.data.frame(flq)
  df$year <- as.numeric(df$year)
  if (!"lbnd" %in% names(df)) df$lbnd <- NA
  if (!"ubnd" %in% names(df)) df$ubnd <- NA
  df$series <- name
  df[, c("year", "value", "lbnd", "ubnd", "series")]
}

round_digits <- function(series) ifelse(series == "Mean F", 4, 0)
```

```{r load}
benchmark  <- new.env(); load("model/model_benchmark.RData",  envir = benchmark)
obsvarpool <- new.env(); load("model/model_obsvarpool.RData", envir = obsvarpool)
final      <- new.env(); load("model/model_final.RData",      envir = final)

# named list of model environments - add/remove entries here to change which
# runs appear throughout this report; every comparison below loops over this
envs   <- list(benchmark = benchmark, obsvarpool = obsvarpool, final = final)
models <- setNames(as.list(names(envs)), names(envs))

find_previous_assessment <- function(stockcode) {
  cur_dir  <- normalizePath(".")
  cur_year <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(sub("^([0-9]{4}).*", "\\1", basename(cur_dir))))
  sibs     <- list.dirs(dirname(cur_dir), recursive = FALSE, full.names = TRUE)
  cand     <- sibs[grepl(paste0("^[0-9]{4}_", stockcode, "_assessment$"), basename(sibs))]
  cand_yr  <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(sub("^([0-9]{4}).*", "\\1", basename(cand))))
  keep     <- !is.na(cand_yr) & !is.na(cur_year) & cand_yr < cur_year
  if (!any(keep)) return(NULL)
  cand[keep][which.max(cand_yr[keep])]
}

prev_dir  <- find_previous_assessment("hom.27.4bc7d")
prev_base <- if (!is.null(prev_dir)) file.path(prev_dir, "model", "model_base.RData") else NULL
have_prev <- !is.null(prev_base) && file.exists(prev_base)

if (have_prev) {
  prev <- new.env(); load(prev_base, envir = prev)
  prevYr <- dims(prev$NSHOM)$maxyear
  prev_label <- paste0(prevYr, "-terminal")
  models_all <- c(models, list(prev = prev_label))
} else {
  models_all <- models
}
```

# Model configuration

```{r config-table}
fmt_groups <- function(mat) {
  # collapse a fleet x age group-code matrix into "1 | 2-7 | 8-10 | 11-14" form,
  # per fleet, for compact display
  rows <- sapply(rownames(mat), function(fl) {
    v <- mat[fl, ]
    rl <- rle(v)
    ages <- as.numeric(colnames(mat))
    ends <- cumsum(rl$lengths)
    starts <- ends - rl$lengths + 1
    segs <- mapply(function(s, e) {
      if (s == e) paste0(ages[s]) else paste0(ages[s], "-", ages[e])
    }, starts, ends)
    paste0(fl, ": ", paste(segs, collapse = " | "))
  })
  paste(rows, collapse = "; ")
}

describe_ctrl <- function(e) {
  ctrl <- e$NSHOM.ctrl
  list(
    "Year range"        = paste0(ctrl@range["minyear"], "-", ctrl@range["maxyear"]),
    "Plus group"         = as.character(ctrl@range["plusgroup"]),
    "Fbar range"          = paste0(ctrl@range["minfbar"], "-", ctrl@range["maxfbar"]),
    "cor.F"                = as.character(ctrl@cor.F),
    "residuals"             = as.character(ctrl@residuals),
    "States (F-at-age groups)" = fmt_groups(ctrl@states[rowSums(ctrl@states >= 0) > 0, , drop = FALSE]),
    "F.vars groups"              = fmt_groups(ctrl@f.vars[rowSums(ctrl@f.vars >= 0) > 0, , drop = FALSE]),
    "Obs.vars groups"             = fmt_groups(ctrl@obs.vars[rowSums(ctrl@obs.vars >= 0) > 0, , drop = FALSE]),
    "biomassTreat"                 = paste(ctrl@biomassTreat, collapse = ", "),
    "catch.vars downweighting"      = "startYr:2002 = 0.5, else 1"
  )
}

cfg_mat <- sapply(envs, function(e) unlist(describe_ctrl(e)))
cfg_df <- data.frame(Setting = rownames(cfg_mat), cfg_mat,
                      row.names = NULL, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)
names(cfg_df)[-1] <- names(envs)

differs <- apply(cfg_mat, 1, function(r) length(unique(r)) > 1)
cfg_df$Differs <- differs

DT::datatable(cfg_df, rownames = FALSE,
              caption = "NSHOM.ctrl configuration - red = differs between the models",
              options = list(pageLength = nrow(cfg_df), dom = "t", ordering = FALSE,
                              columnDefs = list(list(visible = FALSE, targets = ncol(cfg_df) - 1))),
              class = "stripe hover") %>%
  DT::formatStyle(names(envs), valueColumns = "Differs",
                   color = DT::styleEqual(c(TRUE, FALSE), c("#c0392b", "inherit")),
                   fontWeight = DT::styleEqual(c(TRUE, FALSE), c("bold", "normal")))
```

# Full SAM parameter tables

```{r partable}
state_like <- c("logF", "logN", "logCatch", "logCatchByFleet", "logfbar", "logLagR", "logLand",
                "logR", "logssb", "logtsb", "beforeLastLogF", "beforeLastLogN",
                "lastLogF", "lastLogN", "missing")
inactive_params <- c("logFScaleMSY", "implicitFunctionDelta", "splinePenalty")

# which fleet(s)/age(s) each numbered instance of a parameter belongs to, read
# directly from each model's own control object - computed per model since
# benchmark and obsvarpool group ages differently for obs.vars
describe_groups <- function(mat) {
  vals <- sort(unique(mat[mat >= 0]))
  setNames(sapply(vals, function(v) {
    idx <- which(mat == v, arr.ind = TRUE)
    fleets <- unique(rownames(mat)[idx[, 1]])
    ages <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(colnames(mat)[idx[, 2]]))
    arng <- if (all(is.na(ages))) NA_character_
            else if (length(unique(ages)) == 1) paste0("age ", unique(ages))
            else paste0("ages ", min(ages, na.rm = TRUE), "-", max(ages, na.rm = TRUE))
    paste0(paste(fleets, collapse = ", "), ifelse(is.na(arng), "", paste0(": ", arng)))
  }), vals)
}

group_labels_for <- function(e) list(
  logFpar      = tryCatch(describe_groups(e$NSHOM.ctrl@catchabilities), error = function(x) NULL),
  logSdLogFsta = tryCatch(describe_groups(e$NSHOM.ctrl@f.vars),         error = function(x) NULL),
  logSdLogN    = tryCatch(describe_groups(e$NSHOM.ctrl@logN.vars),      error = function(x) NULL),
  logSdLogObs  = tryCatch(describe_groups(e$NSHOM.ctrl@obs.vars),       error = function(x) NULL)
)
group_labels_all <- lapply(envs, group_labels_for)  # keyed by env name (== model label)

par_cmp <- bind_rows(lapply(names(envs), function(nm) {
  envs[[nm]]$NSHOM.sam@params %>% mutate(model = models[[nm]])
})) %>%
  mutate(model = factor(model, levels = unlist(models))) %>%
  filter(!name %in% state_like) %>%
  group_by(model, name) %>%
  mutate(occurrence = row_number()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(ages = {
    gl <- group_labels_all[[as.character(model)]]
    g <- gl[[name]]
    if (!is.null(g) && occurrence <= length(g)) g[occurrence] else NA_character_
  }) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(flag = case_when(
    name %in% inactive_params            ~ "not active",
    is.na(std.dev) | !is.finite(std.dev) ~ "check: non-finite SE",
    std.dev > 2                          ~ "check: large SE",
    TRUE                                 ~ "ok"
  ))

par_wide <- par_cmp %>%
  mutate(cell = paste0(round(value, 3), " (", round(std.dev, 3), ")")) %>%
  select(name, occurrence, model, ages, cell) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = model, values_from = c(ages, cell))

names(par_wide) <- c("Parameter", "#", paste0(names(envs), ": fleet/ages"),
                      paste0(names(envs), ": est. (SE)"))
dt(par_wide, pagelength = 15)
```

```{r partable-flags}
flag_wide <- par_cmp %>%
  select(name, occurrence, model, flag) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = model, values_from = flag)

mcols <- unlist(models)
keep <- apply(as.data.frame(flag_wide)[, mcols, drop = FALSE], 1, function(r) any(r != "ok"))
flag_wide <- flag_wide[keep, ]

names(flag_wide) <- c("Parameter", "#", mcols)
dt(flag_wide, caption = "Flagged parameters only (excludes 'ok' and 'not active' in all models)")
```

# Retrospective pattern

```{r retro-plot, fig.width=9, fig.height=5}
plot_retro_obj <- function(retro_list, label) {
  tryCatch({
    p <- plot(as(retro_list, "FLSAMs"))
    # FLSAM's plot.FLSAMs returns a lattice trellis object, not ggplot2 - use
    # lattice's own update(main=) to set a title, not ggplot2's `+ ggtitle()`
    update(p, main = fig(paste0("Retrospective pattern - ", label)))
  }, error = function(e) NULL)
}

# one PNG per model, then embed them all
retro_paths <- character(0)
for (nm in names(envs)) {
  obj <- plot_retro_obj(envs[[nm]]$NSHOM.retro, models[[nm]])
  if (is.null(obj)) next
  f <- file.path(FIG_DIR, sprintf("retrospective_%s.png", nm))
  png(f, width = 9, height = 5, units = "in", res = 300, bg = "white")
  print(obj)
  dev.off()
  retro_paths <- c(retro_paths, f)
}
if (length(retro_paths)) knitr::include_graphics(retro_paths)
```

```{r mohns-rho, results='asis'}
mohn_tab <- function(retro_list, label) {
  tryCatch({
    retro <- as(retro_list, "FLSAMs")
    ref <- max(as.numeric(names(retro_list)))
    m.ssb  <- mohns.rho(retro, type="ssb",  ref.year=ref, span=5); m.ssb$quant  <- "SSB"
    m.fbar <- mohns.rho(retro, type="fbar", ref.year=ref, span=5); m.fbar$quant <- "Fbar"
    m.rec  <- mohns.rho(retro, type="rec",  ref.year=ref, span=5); m.rec$quant  <- "Recruitment"
    m <- do.call(rbind, list(m.ssb, m.fbar, m.rec))
    m <- aggregate(rho ~ quant, subset(m, year != ref), mean)
    m$model <- label
    m
  }, error = function(e) NULL)
}
mohn_all <- bind_rows(lapply(names(envs), function(nm) mohn_tab(envs[[nm]]$NSHOM.retro, models[[nm]])))
if (nrow(mohn_all) > 0) {
  mohn_all$model <- factor(mohn_all$model, levels = unlist(models))
  mohn_wide <- mohn_all %>% select(quant, model, rho) %>% pivot_wider(names_from = model, values_from = rho)
  names(mohn_wide) <- c("Quantity", unlist(models))
  print(htmltools::tagList(dt(mohn_wide, caption = "Mohn's rho", digits = unlist(models))))
}
```

# Leave-one-out pattern

```{r loo, fig.width=11, fig.height=9}
loo_cmp <- function(loo_list, label) {
  if (length(loo_list) <= 1) return(NULL)
  bind_rows(lapply(names(loo_list), function(nm) {
    fit <- loo_list[[nm]]
    bind_rows(
      as_series(tryCatch(ssb(fit),  error = function(e) NULL), "SSB"),
      as_series(tryCatch(fbar(fit), error = function(e) NULL), "Mean F"),
      as_series(tryCatch(rec(fit),  error = function(e) NULL), "Recruitment")
    ) %>% mutate(fleets = nm)
  })) %>% mutate(model = label)
}

loo_all <- bind_rows(lapply(names(envs), function(nm) loo_cmp(envs[[nm]]$NSHOM.loo, models[[nm]])))

if (nrow(loo_all) > 0) {
  loo_all$series <- factor(loo_all$series, levels = c("SSB", "Mean F", "Recruitment"))
  save_and_show(
    ggplot(loo_all, aes(year, value, colour = fleets)) +
      geom_line(linewidth = 0.7) +
      facet_grid(series ~ model, scales = "free_y") +
      labs(x = "Year", y = NULL, colour = "Fleets used", title = fig("Leave-one-out pattern")),
    "leave_one_out.png", width = 11, height = 9
  )
}
```

# Stock-recruitment

```{r stock-recruit, fig.width=9, fig.height=5}
sr_envs <- envs
if (have_prev) sr_envs$prev <- prev

sr_cmp <- bind_rows(lapply(sr_envs, function(e) {
  ssb_yr <- as.data.frame(ssb(e$NSHOM))[, c("year", "data")]; names(ssb_yr) <- c("year", "ssb")
  rec_yr <- as.data.frame(rec(e$NSHOM))[, c("year", "data")]; names(rec_yr) <- c("year", "rec")
  rage <- min(as.numeric(dimnames(e$NSHOM)$age))
  sr_df <- rec_yr; sr_df$year <- as.numeric(sr_df$year) - rage
  merge(sr_df, ssb_yr, by = "year")
}), .id = "which") %>%
  mutate(model = ifelse(which %in% names(models), unlist(models)[which],
                         if (have_prev) prev_label else NA_character_))

save_and_show(
  ggplot(sr_cmp, aes(ssb, rec, colour = model)) +
    geom_path(aes(group = model), alpha = 0.3) +
    geom_point() +
    labs(x = "SSB", y = "Recruitment", colour = NULL, title = fig("Stock-recruitment relationship")),
  "stock_recruit.png", width = 9, height = 5
)
```


# Process (state) variance

```{r process-variance2, fig.width=9, fig.height=5}
proc_list <- lapply(names(envs), function(nm) envs[[nm]]$NSHOM.sam@params %>% mutate(model = models[[nm]]))
if (have_prev) proc_list <- c(proc_list, list(prev$NSHOM.sam@params %>% mutate(model = prev_label)))

proc_cmp <- bind_rows(proc_list) %>%
  filter(name %in% c("logSdLogFsta", "logSdLogN")) %>%
  group_by(model, name) %>%
  mutate(group = paste0(recode(name, logSdLogFsta = "F", logSdLogN = "N (recruitment/state)"),
                         " - group ", row_number())) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(sd = exp(value), lo = exp(value - 1.96 * std.dev), hi = exp(value + 1.96 * std.dev),
         model = factor(model, levels = unlist(models_all)))

save_and_show(
  ggplot(proc_cmp, aes(group, sd, colour = model)) +
    geom_pointrange(aes(ymin = lo, ymax = hi), fatten = 2, position = position_dodge(width = 0.5)) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "Process error SD", colour = NULL, title = fig("Process (state) variance")) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 20, hjust = 1)),
  "process_variance.png", width = 9, height = 5
)
```

# Comparison with the `r if (have_prev) prevYr else "previous"`-terminal assessment

```{r three-way-data}
if (have_prev) {
  three_way <- bind_rows(
    bind_rows(as_series(ssb(prev$NSHOM.sam), "SSB"),
              as_series(fbar(prev$NSHOM.sam), "Mean F"),
              as_series(rec(prev$NSHOM.sam), "Recruitment")) %>% mutate(run = prev_label),
    bind_rows(lapply(names(envs), function(nm) {
      e <- envs[[nm]]
      bind_rows(as_series(ssb(e$NSHOM.sam), "SSB"),
                as_series(fbar(e$NSHOM.sam), "Mean F"),
                as_series(rec(e$NSHOM.sam), "Recruitment")) %>% mutate(run = models[[nm]])
    }))
  )
  three_way$series <- factor(three_way$series, levels = c("SSB", "Mean F", "Recruitment"))
  three_way$run <- factor(three_way$run, levels = c(prev_label, unlist(models)))
}
```

```{r three-way-plot, fig.width=9, fig.height=8, results='asis'}
if (have_prev) {
  # this chunk stays results='asis' for the DT table below, so save the figure
  # explicitly and print() it rather than going through save_and_show()
  p_three_way <- ggplot(three_way, aes(year, value, colour = run)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = prevYr, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey60") +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
    facet_wrap(~series, scales = "free_y", ncol = 1) +
    labs(x = "Year", y = NULL, colour = NULL,
         title = fig("SSB, Mean F, Recruitment - previous vs. all candidate runs")) +
    theme(legend.position = "top")
  ggsave(file.path(FIG_DIR, "three_way_prev_vs_candidates.png"), p_three_way,
         width = 9, height = 8, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
  print(p_three_way)

  pct_tab <- inner_join(
    filter(three_way, run == prev_label, year == prevYr) %>% select(series, prev = value),
    filter(three_way, run != prev_label, year == prevYr) %>% select(series, run, cur = value),
    by = "series"
  ) %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(`This year` = round(cur, round_digits(series)),
           `% revision` = round((cur - prev) / prev * 100, 1)) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    select(series, run, `This year`, `% revision`) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = run, values_from = c(`This year`, `% revision`))

  prev_col <- filter(three_way, run == prev_label, year == prevYr) %>%
    rowwise() %>% mutate(!!prev_label := round(value, round_digits(series))) %>%
    ungroup() %>% select(series, !!prev_label)

  pct_tab <- left_join(prev_col, pct_tab, by = "series")
  numeric_cols <- names(pct_tab)[sapply(pct_tab, is.numeric)]

  print(htmltools::tagList(dt(pct_tab, caption = paste("Revision at", prevYr), digits = numeric_cols)))
}
```
